name: Wikidata

measures.definition: The ISO 3166-2 code of the region a place belongs to (Sicily is IT-82), which the regional tax rules use.

rights.edition: Wikidata structured data, read on demand

fetch.rateLimit: query service: 60 s of query time a minute per client; send a User-Agent

vetted.notes: Maps a GeoNames region id (P1566) to its ISO 3166-2 code (P300); also a fallback place search.

caveats: The query service rate-limits busy clients (HTTP 429); a committed table covers the regions the tax rules need.
